section_summary.extract_value: Study 1 aimed to examine the psychometric properties of a state version of the BAS-2 (SBAS-2), including its factor structure, internal consistency, convergent validity, and incremental validity, as well as sex differences in state body appreciation. The study hypothesized that the modified BAS-2 would maintain its one-factor structure, state BA would positively correlate with life satisfaction and self-esteem while controlling for general body feelings, state BA would negatively correlate with BMI, and men and women would show similar levels of state BA.
